title: 2-D FFT
text: Compute 2-D fast Fourier transform (FFT), 1 input, 1 output, {FFT implementation} sets FFT implementation; {Output in bit-reversed order} sets the bit-reversed output, {Scale result by FFT length} scales output data and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} sets the data type override. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
